scraped.scraped_description: Your starting point for data about local MPs, constituencies, public opinion and the climate and nature movement.

name: Local Intelligence Hub
tagline: Data platform for analyzing local MPs, constituencies, public opinion and climate/nature movement engagement to support campaigning and organizing
sdg_alignment: SDG 16 – Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
dependency_risks: Reliance on data from The Climate Coalition and member organizations
Dependency on mySociety and Green Alliance for operational support

academic_citations.title: The platform economy: restructuring the space of capitalist accumulation
Optimal operation of interconnected energy hubs by using decomposed hybrid particle swarm and interior-point approach
ColabFold: making protein folding accessible to all

policy_outcomes: Supports local climate campaigners in demonstrating public mandate to MPs
documented_limitations: Dataset currency varies by partner update frequency
curation_criteria: Data sourced from parliamentary records, constituency data, and climate movement engagement metrics
contributor_governance: Open source codebase (mySociety); data governance by The Climate Coalition
political_bias_allegations: Platform explicitly supports climate advocacy; data framing oriented toward pro-climate campaigning
political_relevance_summary: Local Intelligence Hub addresses enabling broader democratic participation and making civic data accessible and actionable. It has documented policy impact.

movement_building_utility.notes: Directly supports organizers/campaigners through Data platform for analyzing local MPs, constituencies, public opinion and climate/nature movement engagement to support campaigning and organizing.

generalizability_notes: currently deployed in United Kingdom only, but approach could be adapted to other national contexts.
